evals.name: routes-hit-db-directly
evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR for the backend module in evals/fixtures/bookmarks/ (a Fastify + Drizzle + Postgres API; paths under src/). Review it for architecture / layering problems. Read all the files, then give me a numbered list of findings, each with file:line, what is wrong, and the concrete fix. Only report real problems; don't pad the list.
evals.expected_output: Names all three planted problems with file:line and a fix aligned with the repo's onion-architecture conventions
expectations: Flags routes.ts issuing Drizzle queries / importing db + schema directly (no repository)
Flags raw Drizzle rows being returned from handlers as the API response (no DTO mapping / contract type)
Flags the hand-built 404 reply body instead of throwing NotFoundError from platform/errors.ts
Reports no more than ~2 clearly unrelated/noisy findings beyond the 3 planted problems
Fix follows repo conventions: DB code moves to modules/bookmarks/repository.ts wired via the container, and the sanctioned getContext helper is left alone

evals.name: hidden-side-effects-billing
evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR for the backend modules in evals/fixtures/billing/ (a Fastify + Drizzle + Postgres API; paths under src/). Review them for architecture / layering problems. Read all the files, then give me a numbered list of findings, each with file:line, what is wrong, and the concrete fix. Only report real problems; don't pad the list.
evals.expected_output: Finds the six planted problems (P1-P6) and does not flag the three legitimate-by-design spots (TRAP-1..3)
expectations: P1: Flags the external payment call (payments.charge) made inside db.transaction in BillingService.pay (connection/locks held over a network call; effect can't roll back)
P2: Flags the receipt job handler as not retry-safe/idempotent (email sent before markReceiptSent; a crash or retry re-sends)
P3: Flags runBus.emit('invoice.paid') firing inside the transaction before commit
P4: Flags billing/service.ts importing ../customers/repository.js directly and constructing CustomerRepository (cross-module access should go via the container)
P5: Flags BillingRepository.getById(id) / BillingService.get ignoring workspaceId (cross-tenant read; id-only lookup)
P6: Flags GET /invoices/:id returning the raw Drizzle invoice row (no DTO / response schema)
TRAP-1: Does NOT flag db/seed.ts for Date.now()/new Date()/console.log
TRAP-2: Does NOT flag adapters/payments/amount.ts as a layering violation (pure code under adapters/) and does NOT flag new Date() in the Stripe adapter
TRAP-3: Does NOT flag modules/health/routes.ts (routes-only module with no business rule is legitimate)
